description:
Late Registration continues the social themes introduced in The College Dropout, but now with orchestral production influenced by co-producer Jon Brion. Kanye's newfound success allowed him to expand his ambitions from a single violinist to an entire string orchestra. Lyrically, the album features a mix of more socially charged songs to more personal cuts. Production-wise, inspiration came from artists such as British trip-hop band Portishead and Fiona Apple's second album When The Pawn…

title: Unknown [Diddy Collaborations]
description: On April 21st 2015, Diddy posted to Instagram that Ye had joined his producer team, The Hitmen. Later in May, in response to rumors that he was executive-producing Ye's upcoming album, he stated that it was a "possibility" and that he was producing for the album. Diddy's heavy involvement is also evidenced through the fact that there is multiple voice memos and pieces of studio footage of them together, and the fact that Cassie was wearing an at-the-time unreleased So Help Me God hoodie in the infamous hotel video where Diddy abuses her (later prompting Ye to release the hoodie to yeezy.com in 2025 during his rants about Diddy).
